title: Reuse
info: Reuse means a thing gets another job instead of going in the bin.
Jars, boxes, and cloth bags are easy to reuse.

questions.q: A glass jar used to hold pencils is
Reuse is different from recycle because
options: a factory must always melt it first
you use the same object again
throwing a bottle in the sea
carrying groceries in a cloth bag you already have

questions.q: Fixing a loose button so a shirt lasts longer is
options: a way to keep using it
made to be thrown away after one use

questions.q: Type the word that means use again.
